result.brief: 提出四机制分类法与 EndoClock 审计工具，用于检测多模态医学世界模型流水线中固定网格同步是否在建模前抹除任务相关证据，并以超声心动图为例给出可执行失败预警。
result.reason: Audits synchronization of multimodal medical recordings feeding world models, showing grid resampling can erase task-relevant evidence; directly addresses world-model data pipelines and temporal representation.
